##### Project general facts

Gardenia Livings is a seven-storey apartment building developed by Safe Developers, offering one- and two-bedroom apartments within a modern architectural style. The project emphasizes a comfortable lifestyle with a range of public amenities for residents. The development is situated within the Arjan community, benefiting from evolving infrastructure and a lively environment, with anticipated completion this year.

Amenities within Gardenia Livings include a wide variety of public facilities designed for resident enjoyment. These facilities cater to recreation, relaxation, and social activities, providing opportunities for exercise, leisure, and communal gatherings. Residents will have access to a central park with a running track, children's activities, and sports areas, directly accessible from the development.

Interiors feature high-quality flooring and imported European sanitaryware. Fully fitted modern kitchens are provided with stone countertops. Furnishing is included, ensuring a complete living space upon occupancy.

##### Location description and benefits

Arjan is a master-planned development that offers a mix of apartments, townhouses, and commercial spaces, and is considered one of the emerging areas in Dubai. The community is located near the popular attractions of Dubai, such as the Dubai Miracle Garden and the Mall of the Emirates.

Arjan offers various amenities to its residents, including landscaped gardens, swimming pools, fitness centers, and retail outlets. It is a family-friendly community with a safe and secure environment. There are several schools, healthcare facilities, and supermarkets in the area, making it a convenient place to live.

The community also features several parks and playgrounds, providing residents with opportunities for outdoor activities and recreational opportunities. Arjan is well-connected to the rest of Dubai through the Dubai-Al Ain Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, and the Al Khail Road, making it easy to access other parts of the city.
